Founding member of the Professional Association of Parasail Operators (PAPO)
Flights up to 800 feet for panoramic ocean views

blurb: Guests board a boat and are lifted into the air by a parasail attached to the boat. Flights last about 1.25 hours including boat time, with options for 600-foot or 800-foot flights. Safety gear and trained guides are included, and a GoPro photo/video package is available.
extraNote: No refunds if cancelled within 48 hours of departure; 50% refund if cancelled earlier · Full value gift pass for cancellations within 7 days but outside 48 hours, no refunds on gift passes · No refunds for no-shows or late arrivals (more than 30 minutes late) · Company may cancel for weather or mechanical issues with full refund or future trip credit · Zero tolerance for drug or alcohol use onboard; intoxicated passengers may be removed without refund · Check-in and departure from the boat at the marina (exact location provided after booking) · March through December (subject to change)
